text:
sam: Heads-up: marketplace listing preflight is tomorrow 09:30 PT. Need final signoff on published metadata, partner quote, and SI onboarding flow. Can people confirm owners?

lorna: I'll own metadata + listing copy. I will push final hero copy by EOD today.

diego: I'll validate the SI auth flow (service account / webhook) and run a provisioning smoke. I saw a webhook 403 last week.

clare: I have the partner quote approved but need the partner's short bio for the blog. Partner asked for a single-sentence quote tweak.

partner-riya: Riya (SI): sending bio now. Small tweak ok. Also flag: our registry upload CI failed yesterday (permissions). Will work with Diego.

ops-bot: CI alert: partner-registry-upload failed on step 'docker push' (403). See run 2026-03-22T18:14Z.

diego: Putting a short test plan here:
```
- validate webhook HMAC header
- test provisioning with sample tenant id: tenant-test-451
- run docker push using partner token (rotate if 403)
- verify SKU mapping in listing metadata
```

diego: @partner-riya can you confirm the service account scopes and that your CI token can push to test registry?

partner-riya: Confirmed: token has push on repo:test-listings. I will rotate token and re-run in 20m.

lorna: Metadata checklist:
- product short/long descriptions done
- hero image (2x) approved by design
- legal alt text & trademark block included
- SKU IDs aligned with billing team
- categories/tags mapped for regional catalogs

clare: Blog plan: publish + partner quote + CTO note. Need final CTO line by 12:00 PT. Press embargo set to 2026-03-24T16:00Z.

press-bot: Noted embargo 2026-03-24T16:00Z. Reminder scheduled at T-24h and T-2h.

sam: Contingency: if registry push not cleared by 08:30 PT, we will publish the listing without container integration and mark it as "Marketplace listing (integration pending)" with a CTA to request demo. Diego will add feature flag UX.

diego: I can flip the feature flag. Where do we host fallback copy?

lorna: Put fallback copy in the marketplace CMS under /drafts/fallback-integration. I'll push an early version now.

partner-riya: I've rotated token and re-ran CI. Push succeeded on attempt #3. Sending logs to the channel.

ops-bot: CI run success: docker push completed. Artifact: partner-listing:sha-7a1b.

diego: Re-ran provisioning smoke against tenant-test-451: success. Webhook HMAC validated. SKU mapping looks good.

clare: Got CTO line at 11:10 PT. Passing to editorial.

sam: Owners recap: Lorna=metadata & copy; Diego=SI auth & provisioning; Clare=blog + quotes; Riya=partner CI/token; Ops-bot=CI alerts; Press-bot=embargo reminders.

sam: Final: react with :rocket: when your part is green. I'll open the 09:30 PT preflight meeting and share the rehearsal checklist.

lorna: :rocket: metadata pushed to staging.

diego: :rocket: SI smoke green.

clare: :rocket: blog queued for editorial review.

partner-riya: :rocket: CI clean. Thanks team!
